nodes.label: Docker socket mount = host root
nodes.rationale: Mounting /var/run/docker.sock into the daemon container gives it host root — the Docker API is unnamespaced, so a compromise starts a container that mounts / as root. The largest hole; it survives every other change.

nodes.label: Native systemd daemon (hardened)
nodes.rationale: Recommended: run the daemon as a host process under systemd (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateTmp, ReadWritePaths) instead of a socket-mounted container. Removes the socket-in-a-container hole; docker-group still equals root, which the microvm tier is what actually contains.

nodes.label: Fixed-schema host helper (option 2)
nodes.rationale: If the daemon must stay containerized, replace the socket with a tiny host helper accepting only create/destroy/list over a unix socket with a fixed argument schema, so the daemon can't ask the host for arbitrary Docker actions.
